propertySets.name: Pset_Condition
propertySets.definition: Determines the state or condition of an element at a particular point in time.

properties.name: AssessmentDate
properties.definition: Date on which the overall condition is assessed

properties.name: AssessmentCondition
properties.definition: The overall condition of a product based on an assessment of the contributions to the overall condition made by the various criteria considered. The meanings given to the values of assessed condition should be agreed and documented by local agreements. For instance, is overall condition measured on a scale of 1 - 10 or by assigning names such as Good, OK, Poor.

properties.name: AssessmentDescription
properties.definition: Qualitative description of the condition.

properties.name: AssessmentType
properties.definition: Category of latest condition assessment report of the asset.

properties.name: AssessmentMethod
properties.definition: External reference to assessment method or application used to perform the assessment.

properties.name: LastAssessmentReport
properties.definition: Reference to latest condition (state of health) report.

properties.name: NextAssessmentDate
properties.definition: Date of next condition inspection

properties.name: AssessmentFrequency
properties.definition: Indicates how often the equipment should be assessed, to have a clear estimation on its working state, based on which the maintenance staff can decide whether it requires maintenance or requires to be updated or replaced.

propertySets.name: Pset_InstallationOccurrence
propertySets.definition: Properties defining installation information for occurrences of element, asset or system.

properties.name: InstallationDate
properties.definition: Date on which the element is installed.

properties.name: AcceptanceDate
properties.definition: Date on which the element is accepted by the manager or administrator.

properties.name: PutIntoOperationDate
properties.definition: Date on which the element is put into operation.

propertySets.name: Pset_MaintenanceStrategy
propertySets.definition: Property set for the association of a maintenance strategy to an element, asset of system.

properties.name: AssetCriticality
properties.definition: Rating of the asset's criticality to the operation of the facility

properties.name: AssetFrailty
properties.definition: Rating of the asset's frailty to breakage or deterioration

properties.name: AssetPriority
properties.definition: Combined criticality and frailty rating indicating the operational and maintenance priority of the asset

properties.name: MonitoringType
properties.definition: Monitoring strategy chosen for the asset

properties.name: AccidentResponse
properties.definition: Accident response chosen for the asset

propertySets.name: Pset_MaintenanceTriggerCondition
propertySets.definition: Trigger levels for an asset that has an inspection-based maintenance strategy

properties.name: ConditionTargetPerformance
properties.definition: Target condition of the asset

properties.name: ConditionMaintenanceLevel
properties.definition: Condition that will trigger maintenance

properties.name: ConditionReplacementLevel
properties.definition: Condition that will trigger a replacement process

properties.name: ConditionDisposalLevel
properties.definition: Condition that will trigger a disposal process

propertySets.name: Pset_MaintenanceTriggerDuration
propertySets.definition: Trigger levels for an asset that has an PPM based maintenance strategy.

properties.name: DurationTargetPerformance
properties.definition: Target time to failure of the asset

properties.name: DurationMaintenanceLevel
properties.definition: Duration interval at which maintenance is performed

properties.name: DurationReplacementLevel
properties.definition: Duration interval at which replacement is performed

properties.name: DurationDisposalLevel
properties.definition: Duration interval at which disposal is performed

propertySets.name: Pset_MaintenanceTriggerPerformance
propertySets.definition: Properties for performance based maintenance policies

properties.name: TargetPerformance
properties.definition: Target capacity or performance of the asset. Units of the performance value are specified through the propertyValue units attribute.

properties.name: PerformanceMaintenanceLevel
properties.definition: Performance level at which maintenance takes place

properties.name: ReplacementLevel
properties.definition: Performance level at which replacement takes place

properties.name: DisposalLevel
properties.definition: Performance level at which disposal takes place

propertySets.name: Pset_RepairOccurrence
propertySets.definition: Properties defining repair information for occurrences of element, asset or system.

properties.name: RepairContent
properties.definition: Content of repair, reason and nature can be given, e.g. display faults, communication failure, display exchange.

properties.name: RepairDate
properties.definition: Date on which the last repair is done on the asset.

properties.name: MeanTimeToRepair
properties.definition: Mean time to repair.

propertySets.name: Pset_ServiceLifeFactors
propertySets.definition: Captures various factors that impact the expected service life of elements within the system or zone.

properties.name: QualityOfComponents
properties.definition: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of the quality of components used.

properties.name: DesignLevel
properties.definition: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of design level employed.

properties.name: WorkExecutionLevel
properties.definition: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of the quality of work executed.

properties.name: IndoorEnvironment
properties.definition: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of the indoor environment (where appropriate).

properties.name: OutdoorEnvironment
properties.definition: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of the outdoor environment (where appropriate)

properties.name: InUseConditions
properties.definition: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of the conditions in which components are operating.

properties.name: MaintenanceLevel
properties.definition: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of the level or degree of maintenance applied to dcomponents.
